integrity: Finite-field enumeration and symbolic graded proof are included; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Does not extend to other exponent, rank or modules; historical priority not independently established; finite checks not an infinite proof.
scope: All nonunit augmentation elements of the regular representation of F_q[C_3 x C_3] over q=3^f for f >=1; exact joint ranks and Jordan multiplicities.
title: Characteristic-three Jordan strata of the two-generator elementary-abelian group algebra
